cases.verifiedFact: Southwestern Oklahoma State's official 2026 schedule labels its October 17 home game against Southern Nazarene Canceled. The official Great American Conference schedule lists the matchup on November 21 and conference statistics list both teams' eight completed games through October 31 without this matchup. Southern Nazarene's older schedule page still lists October 15 without a result, so the original timestamp is inconsistent across sources.
cases.suggestedResearchTreatment: Exclude the unplayed original slot from a completed-results research graph; do not count a tie. A later November 21 result must be admitted only if actually completed and available at its own cutoff. Preserve the date discrepancy in the audit.

cases.verifiedFact: Both schools' official September 5 recaps state that regulation ended 16-16, extreme heat prevented overtime, and the teams and officials declared the contest complete as a tie. The official schedules and RMAC schedule also label it T 16-16.
cases.sourceDiscrepancy: Mines' cumulative-statistics result table labels the same 16-16 score L and has an inconsistent running record. The two dated official recaps explicitly certify a tie, so that single table label must not be used to invent a winner.
cases.suggestedResearchTreatment: Retain this zero-outcome edge. The saved final margin is already mathematically correct. Absolute score metadata could be corrected to 16-16 if stored, but changing 0-margin totals does not change the existing margin/outcome-based calculations. Do not apply a blanket ban on tied lower-division games.

cases.verifiedFact: Both Fort Lewis and William Jewell official 2026 schedules mark the August 29 matchup in Liberty, Missouri Canceled. The official GLVC schedule leaves that entry without a final result.
cases.suggestedResearchTreatment: Exclude from completed-results research input; no win, loss or tie should be invented.

cases.verifiedFact: A Western Connecticut State release dated September 25, 2026 explicitly cancels the September 26 home football game against Kean due to the impending storm. The official NJAC Kean schedule omits that game from its completed results.
cases.suggestedResearchTreatment: Exclude from completed-results research input; the dated pregame cancellation is positive evidence, unlike simply finding an empty score field.

cases.verifiedFact: Plymouth State's official September 25 release states that its previously scheduled October 10 non-conference home game against Framingham State was canceled so that the postponed Mass Maritime game could occupy that date. Plymouth's official season schedule separately lists an October 31 game at Framingham State, lost 0-14.
cases.suggestedResearchTreatment: Exclude the canceled October 10 slot, retaining the separate completed October 31 game. Never collapse legitimate rematches solely because opponent identities match.
